## Spatial concentration

@fig-spatial-concentration-bar compares the share of primary residences and gatherings across community districts. Within each borough, a few districts were over-represented among gatherings relative to where participants lived—specifically BK01 (Williamsburg–Greenpoint), MN04 (Chelsea-Hudson Yards), and QN05 (Ridgewood). These places mark the city’s social centers: where people converged for nightlife, group gatherings, and sexual contact, amplifying both community connection and opportunities for transmission.
